# Morris Focus

> > Morris Focus is a hyperlocal news hub dedicated to comprehensive coverage of Morris County, New Jersey communities, featuring breaking news, community events, and investigative reporting.

Morris Focus serves as the primary news source for Morris County residents, covering multiple townships and municipalities including Hanover, East Hanover, Madison, Florham Park, Boonton, Mountain Lakes, Morris Plains, Dover, and Jefferson Township. The publication combines breaking news, community coverage, and investigative journalism on topics ranging from law enforcement to local education and civic issues.

## Morris County Communities

- [Morris County Hub](https://morrisfocus.com/morris-county-2): Morris County news hub covering Hanover, East Hanover, Madison, Florham Park, Boonton, Mountain Lakes.
- [Local News](https://morrisfocus.com/local-news): Local news section serving multiple Morris County communities and townships.
- [Jefferson Township](https://morrisfocus.com/jefferson-township): Jefferson Township community profile featuring sports programs and township coverage.
- [Hanover](https://morrisfocus.com/local-news/hanover): Hanover Township news covering license plate readers, e-bike laws, surveillance.
- [East Hanover](https://morrisfocus.com/local-news/east-hanover): East Hanover local news covering law enforcement, recreation, and community events.
- [Madison](https://morrisfocus.com/local-news/madison): Madison local news covering community events and chamber of commerce activities.
- [Florham Park](https://morrisfocus.com/local-news/florham-park): Florham Park news including police department updates and junior police academy.
- [Morris Plains](https://morrisfocus.com/local-news/morris-plains): Morris Plains community news featuring events, VFW outings, and museum announcements.
- [Mountain Lakes](https://morrisfocus.com/local-news/mountain-lakes): Mountain Lakes news including community events and crime reports.
- [Dover](https://morrisfocus.com/jeffersonfocus/dover): Dover news covering law enforcement and Jefferson Township community events.

## Breaking News & Investigations

- [Law Enforcement Announces Arrests in Connection with Dover Kidnapping](https://morrisfocus.com/2026/03/20/law-enforcement-announces-arrests-in-connection-with-dover-kidnapping): Breaking news on Dover kidnapping arrests announced by Morris County law enforcement.
- [Governor Sherrill, Attorney General Davenport, Roxbury Township Sue ICE, DHS Over Plans to Convert Warehouse into Mass Detention Facility](https://morrisfocus.com/2026/03/20/governor-sherrill-attorney-general-davenport-roxbury-township-sue-ice-dhs-over-plans-to-convert-warehouse-into-mass-detention-facility): News report on legal challenge to ICE detention facility conversion in Roxbury Township.
- [How License Plate Readers are Quietly Tracking Drivers](https://morrisfocus.com/2026/03/10/how-license-plate-readers-are-quietly-tracking-drivers): Investigative article on license plate reader surveillance technology in Morris County.
